python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -3
python3 -c "
from miniconf.loader import load
c=load('examples/service.conf');print(c.get('level',section='logging'),c.get('port',section='http'),c.get('name'))"
python3 - <<'EOF'
import tempfile, os
from miniconf.loader import load
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    w=lambda n,t: open(os.path.join(d,n),'w').write(t)
    os.mkdir(os.path.join(d,'sub'))
    w('a.conf','a=1\n@include b.conf\n'); w('b.conf','@include a.conf\n')
    w('c.conf','@include nope.conf\n')
    w('sub/x.conf','x=1\n@include y.conf\n'); w('sub/y.conf','y=2\nx=9\n')
    w('top.conf','@include sub/x.conf\ny=5\n')
    for f in ['a.conf','c.conf']:
        try: load(os.path.join(d,f))
        except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__,e)
    c=load(os.path.join(d,'top.conf')); print(c.get('x'),c.get('y'))
EOF
